Even more surprising is the 'Demon Crate', a racing parts kit that Dodge sold to buyers for just one dollar extra. The equipment, said to be valued at over six thousand dollars, included thinner front wheels and a high-octane tuned ECU for drag racing as well as air filters and a race spec instrument panel.

The SRT Demon was even banned from racing in stock condition by the NHRA (National Hot Rod Association) who stated the car was too fast to compete without a roll cage or parachute. The Demon is certain to go down in Dodge history as one of their greatest monsters.
DescriptionLong.0x00007F6E:
Since its introduction in 2012, more than 200,000 units of the Toyota 86 were sold around the world, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular front-engine/rear-wheel drive compact sports cars of all time.

Nine years after the 86's debut, Toyota introduced the GR86, a high-performance version of the car that wore the Gazoo Racing badge (GR). While maintaining the virtues of the original car, namely a lightweight body and superb handling, Toyota engineers equipped the GR86 with a larger engine. Under the bonnet was a 2.4-litre flat-4 that replaced the 2.0-litre variant. Power came in at an impressive <235ps>/<7000rpm> with maximum torque peaking at <25.5kgm>/<3700rpm>. This translated to a 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of 6.3 seconds, which was a stark improvement over the 7.4 seconds of the first-generation model.

To enhance the 86's handling, the company's chassis engineers stiffened the body and adopted aluminium in the roof panel to lower the centre of gravity, as well as reduce overall weight. With the GR86, Toyota offered sports-car enthusiasts exactly what they were hoping for with the 86: a meaner, faster version of the car that was designed for the race track.
DescriptionLong.0x00007F6F:
Since its debut in 2014, the Mercedes-AMG GT has seen a number of variations including roadsters, 4-door coupés and high performance editions but in 2020 the ultimate AMG GT model was introduced. This was the AMG GT Black Series.

The Black Series name is given to limited production models developed to include as much of the technology developed by Mercedes-AMG in their motorsports endeavours as is possible on a production model platform.

The sixth of these Black Series models, this model features a specially tuned 4L V8 twin-turbo engine increasing the power and torque to <730ps> and 800 Nm (<81.57kgm>) respectively. In order to effectively transfer this power the 7-speed DCT transmission has also been strengthened and the gear ratios revised. As a result the car is able to accelerate from 0-<100km/h> in 3.2s, 0-<200km/h> within 9s and reach a top speed of <325km/h>.

The suspension has also been modified and a number of material and construction changes have been made across the car to improve handing and cornering ability.

The bodywork also features various racing car styles modifications but these are all strictly due to necessity.
DescriptionLong.0x00007F70:
Every generation of the Ford Mustang has featured high performance sports models and in its long history there have even been models designed specifically for use in motorsports.

The most apparent of these came during the car's first generation. In particular, the GT350, developed by Shelby American for SCCA races, had an illustrious career in motorsport and became famous around the world.

However, the Boss series produced only in 1969 and 1970 has just as much historical value. Introduced to meet engine production numbers for NASCAR homologation, the Boss 429 is hailed by some enthusiasts as the greatest model in the history of the Mustang.

The 7L V8 429 engine is the largest ever fitted on a Mustang. While officially rated at <375ps>, racing engines of the time were often underquoted on power and the engine was rumoured to actually produce somewhere near <600ps>.

The iconic large bonnet scoop was only equipped on the Boss 429 model.e
DescriptionLong.0x00007F71:
Starting in 1948, Porsche has founded its reputation as one of the world’s premier automotive manufacturers by creating supremely elegant and lightweight sports cars. Sports cars which are not defined by extreme horsepower, but which are instead characterised by a highly efficient power/weight ratio combined with timeless and efficient design.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo follows in this tradition of the German manufacturer and is at the same time a truly modern and bold statement about the future of the sports car. It merges elements of the iconic design of historic Porsche sports cars with race car genes of the record-breaking 919 Hybrid and the pioneering spirit of Porsche’s first electric sports car, the Taycan, into a high-performance lightweight sports car.

Exterior and interior design flow seamlessly into one another and provide drivers with the feeling of becoming one with the car – especially once they take a seat in the cockpit of the state-of-the-art carbon monocoque chassis, and the spectacular glass dome closes around them.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo’s dual electric engine layout delivers a system power output of 820 kW (<1114ps>) and a maximum torque of 1,090 Nm (<111kgm>). An innovative active aerodynamic system dynamically reacts to all driving situations to enhance the car’s performance. Perfectly suited for the demanding corners and high-speed segments found on tracks like the Nürburgring Nordschleife or on alpine roads.
DescriptionLong.0x00007F72:
After the S14 failed to achieve commercial success, the 7th generation Silvia (S15) made its appearance on the scene in January 1999. The biggest selling point of the S15 was that its body size was reduced, putting it in the same size class as the S13. It clearly tried to distance itself from the previous deviation towards luxury and set its direction as an appropriately sized FR sportscar.

The S15 continued to use the SR20 engine found in the S13 and S14. Fine tuning had progressed even further, with the naturally aspirated version producing <165ps> and <19.6kgm> torque, with the turbo version producing <250ps> and <28.0kgm> torque. The S15 was offered in two main grades, the naturally aspirated Spec S, and the turbocharged Spec R. Manual versions of the Spec R received a 6-speed transmission.

The S15 inherited its chassis from the S13 and S14, but to increase its appeal as an FR sport model, a major revision was made. By improving body rigidity, braking power and the suspension, and by adding a helical LSD, performance was increased dramatically in comparison to the previous model.

The Spec R, with its <250ps> engine and 6-speed manual transmission, boasted an admirable weight-to-power ratio of <4.96kg/ps>. Its ideal handling and high level of performance allowed drivers to feel a sense of flexible manoeuvrability. In the year 2000, a convertible model, the Varietta, was introduced with a naturally aspirated engine.

Though the S15 was the only compact FR car left in Japan, it didn't meet the exhaust emission standards for year 2000 and production ceased in August 2002. This marked the end to the Silvia dynasty that had lasted for an incredible 38 years.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.g
DescriptionLong.0x00007F7F:
The 205 Turbo 16 is a Group B car developed by Peugeot for the World Rally Championship. Though similar to the production 205 in both looks and name, the car is an entirely different beast on the inside.

Built on a pipe frame chassis, in the space where the rear seats would normally go sits 1.8L inline-4 DOHC turbo engine producing over <350ps>. The drivetrain is of course a full-time four-wheel drive configuration and features double wishbone suspension on all four wheels. In order to improve ease-of-maintenance for the engine and rear suspension the rear half of the body shell from the B pillar back is a single fibreglass piece that can be lifted up and out of the way.

Debuting at the 1984 Tour de Corse, the 205 Turbo 16 soon gained 3 victories with another 3 following in '85. However, Peugeot were not satisfied with these results and produced an extra limited run of 20 specially modified cars. Featuring a lighter frame, an improved engine, and a large rear-wing, the 205 Turbo Evolution 2 became known as one of the monsters of Group B.

With these improvement in place, few could stand up to the Peugeot teams. In Group B, they won 7 out of the 12 events in 1985 and 6 out of 13 in 1986, earning them both the manufacturers' and drivers' championship titles 2 years running.

However, the FIA decided to discontinue the Group B category at the end of 1986. The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 was remembered as one of the most iconic cars of the era.A
DescriptionLong.0x00008209:
A sportscar was displayed at the Mazda booth of the 2015 Tokyo Motorshow, and garnered great attention from its visitors. It was called the RX-VISION, with a subname, ‘Rotary Sports Concept’.

The smooth, long nosed, short deck form absent of any unnecessary lines or surfaces, was based on the KODO design philosophy of Mazda, and pursued the ultimate beauty of a front engine, rear wheel drive sportscar. Its silhouette was a tell-tale sign of its 2 seater, front midship layout.

While details were not disclosed, the engine was described to be the next generation Skyactiv-R rotary engine.

The catchphrase included the words, ‘a dream to hopefully achieve one day’. This is also a dream that a large number of rotary engine fans around the world would like to see come to life.

Even before the street model of this car was revealed, the RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT was already made drivable in Gran Turismo Sport.
DescriptionLong.0x000084A7:
Since its release in 2018 the ZC33 Swift Sport has been lauded by automobile enthusiasts as a compact and fun to drive hot hatch, citing its lightweight high-rigidity body, responsive high-torque 1.4L turbo engine and European tuned handling.
 
Unveiled at the 2020 Tokyo Auto Salon, the 'KATANA Edition' concept is a suggestion for the future evolution of the model, expressing the power and the beauty of the high performance Katana motorcycle through the Swift Sport. The idea was something only possible from the sporting minds of Suzuki, one only a few manufacturers in the world to produce both motorbikes and cars.
 
The design uses the Suzuki Swift as a base adding bespoke front and rear bumpers featuring design elements from the Katana. The exaggerated fender flares widen the car further, accentuating the Swift Sport's glamorous silhouette. The interior uses burnt titanium coloured panels simulating a hot exhaust as well as other elements to provide the look and feel of a sports bike. Additionally, both the interior and exterior feature red accents and Katana logos throughout.
 
In addition to the 2-tone Katana silver and matte black design as seen at the Tokyo Auto Salon, 5 other colour variations have been added. The 'Candy Daring Red' variant features the same body colour as the limited edition Katana bike which was sold in a limited run of 100 units in January 2021.
 
This special version featured in Gran Turismo has been slightly modified in design and specification to compete in the Gr.4 category. The front under spoiler has been enlarged and a unique GT wing designed to reflect the shape of the Katana's seat cowling has been added. Along with different sized tyres, interior weight reduction, a roll cage and a tuned up engine, the car has evolved into a Gran Turismo Gr.4 spec race machine.
DescriptionLong.0x00008BD5:
Suzuki is one of a small number of manufacturers to produce both cars and motorbikes. First introduced 20 years ago, the GSX-R/4 sports concept was developed as the amalgamation of their 2 and 4 wheeled sports vehicles. It featured the high performance engine from Suzuki's 'Hayabusa' flagship sports bike mounted in the midship position on a lightweight aluminium framed car body. The GSX-R/4 has also appeared in previous Gran Turismo titles.

And now, the latest evolution of the Hayabusa engine returns together with Suzuki's latest developments in electrification and lightweight construction methods to produce the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

The car is based on a front-engine, rear-wheel layout with the new Hayabusa 1,340cm³ (<1340cc>) engine located in a front-midship position. This is combined with 2 electric motors driving the front wheels and 1 driving the rear to produce an all-wheel drive layout. This combination of an engine and electric motors is able to produce a combined maximum power output of 318kW (<432ps>) and 610Nm (<62kgm>)/3000rpm maximum torque. This together with all of Suzuki's lightweight construction methods in a compact <970kg> 2-seat open body results in a super sports machine.

The exterior design combines the DNA of Suzuki's sporting heritage as represented by the Swift Sport with a long nose silhouette reminiscent of the classic Cappuccino. The interior design, similar to the GSX-R/4, has the aesthetics of a motorcycle frame and expresses the joy of driving in a modern pure sports fashion.
DescriptionLong.0x00008BE3:
The 'kei' vehicle specification is unique to Japan, where they serve an important role in everyday life. While the engine displacement and body size are kept to a bare minimum, there are a number of models that make this part of their charm while exhibiting formidable performance.

One such car is the Daihatsu Copen, a convertible with real sporting potential. The second generation model, which debuted in 2014, features a robust 'D-Frame' body structure housing a 3-cylinder turbo engine with variable valve timing. It also features the playful 'Dress-Formation' system which allows body panels to be easily removed and replaced to change the look of the car.

Using this as a base, the COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo endeavoured to explore the full potential of kei cars. RJ stands for 'Racing Jacket' referring to the almost armour like exterior which embodies the anticipation of racing victory.

The car actually looks like a warrior. Equipped for battle with its oversized front under spoiler, rear wing and diffusers, and with the fender flares increasing its width, it gives off an incredibly striking image.

The engine displacement is still <660cc> as per kei regulations but the boost pressure has been increased to its very limits to achieve <149ps>/<20.6kgm>. Additionally, the body weight has been reduced to just <600kg> giving the car the racing potential to stand up to sports cars with much bigger engines.

In the 1960s, Daihatsu competed in motorsports with their classic P-5. The COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo is an aspirational work that carries on their fighting spirit.
DescriptionLong.0x00008BE5:
The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Roadster is an all-electric single-seater which combines a race-proven, state-of-the art powertrain with a taut, sculpted form inspired by the iconic, timeless Jaguar D-type.

Following the success of the original Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Coupé and Vision Gran Turismo SV endurance racer, the Gran Turismo Roadster is designed to bring gamers the pure, visceral driving experience of an open-cockpit Jaguar sports car powered by three electric motors generating a total power output of more than <1000ps>.

The flowing surfaces, dramatic lines and perfect proportions of the first two Jaguar Gran Turismo Vision cars are instantly recognisable, but in place of a deployable canopy is a swept-back aero screen directly in front of the driver. Behind, a modern interpretation of the fin synonymous of the three-time Le Mans-winning D-type, aerodynamically optimised using the latest computational fluid dynamics tools to be deployable at speed for enhanced stability with minimal drag.

The fin also features one of the beautiful details to be found thoughout the Roadster, here in the form of a Union Jack etched – using the Jaguar monogram pattern – into the fin itself, and subtly illuminated by LEDs. The theme continues with the hand-crafted leather straps on the front fenders and iconic roundel lights in the front grille.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Roadster’s dramatic, driver-focused interior combines lightweight, luxurious materials and finishes with stunningly intricate details. Looking out onto the gracefully long bonnet, gamers will be fully immersed in the action.
DescriptionLong.0x0000923D:
The ZR1 has made its name as a high-performance version of the Chevrolet Corvette. The seventh generation C7 Corvettes already had an impressive line-up, including the sporty Z51 and the powerful Z06, but in 2018, as the generation neared its end, the mightiest C7 of all was released in the form of the ZR1.

The ZR1 features a supercharged 6.2L V8 LT5 engine. It features a similar construction to the <659ps> 881Nm （<89.84kgm>) LT4 engine from the Z06, but the increased capacity of the supercharger and the addition of GM's first dual injection system means that it's capable of <765ps> and 969Nm (<98.8kgm>)—a performance increase of more than 10%.

The car's aerodynamic parts were newly developed in conjunction with Pratt & Miller Engineering, who are known for entering Corvettes into GT races. The focus was always on performance—for example, two different rear wings were developed for the ZR1, one designed for maximum speed, the other for the fastest possible lap time. When the car is optimised for maximum speed, it is capable of hitting <345.8km/h>.n
DescriptionLong.0x0000923F:
The G70 is a sports sedan, developed as part of Hyundai's high-performance Genesis brand. A standard D-segment vehicle, it was first released in 2017 and intended as an entry-level Genesis model.

Despite sharing most of its features, including the platform, with the KIA Stinger (KIA are also part of the Hyundai group), the G70 was designed from the ground up as a luxury sedan.

Three engines were made available for the G70: a 3.3L V6 twin turbo, a 2L petrol turbo, and a 2.2L diesel turbo. The V6 twin turbo was capable of <370ps>. Like the other cars in the Genesis line-up, rear-wheel drive and AWD versions of the G70 were produced.

The G70's styling was an instant hit, widely praised for it elegant outline. In 2020, however, the car underwent a major redesign, intended to make it more similar to the luxurious G90 and G80. As a result, the G70 looked more polished, and even more striking.

In 2021, a shooting brake model, based on the sedan, was produced for the European market. Its stunning style made it an instant hit.
DescriptionLong.0x00009241:
In April 2021, the premium brand Genesis unveiled their Genesis X concept, a study in the form GT cars could take in the near future.

The front fascia features the shield-shaped crest grill that has become the brand's identity, with 2 lines coming out of the sides to form headlights. These lines stretch past the front wheel arches and reappear again at the rear of the car to form the tail lights. This new-generation example of artistic design is an innovative interpretation of Genesis's 'Athletic Elegance' design language.

This model was more than a concept, however. Genesis also conceived of a racing edition for Gran Turismo which uses the concepts and design essence of the Genesis X. The Genesis X Gr.3 is a top class Gr.3 spec machine, designed for victory in fierce championship competition.

The X concept was originally designed as an electric vehicle, but the Genesis X Gr.3 uses a conventional internal combustion engine at its heart. With forced induction, the engine is able to produce a maximum of <550ps>. In order to fit larger tyres, the body has been widened to <1992mm>, and aerodynamic improvements have been added to the underside as well as a larger wing on the rear of the car to complete the image of a formidable racing machine.

A combination of luxury and competition performance, the Genesis X Gr.3 is a radical new type of Gr.3 machine, the likes of which have never been seen before.
DescriptionLong.0x00009243:
The G70 is a sports sedan, developed as part of Hyundai's high-performance Genesis brand. A standard D-segment vehicle, it was first released in 2017 and intended as an entry-level Genesis model.

Despite sharing most of its features, including the platform, with the KIA Stinger (KIA are also part of the Hyundai group), the G70 was designed from the ground up as a luxury sedan.

Three engines were made available for the G70: a 3.3L V6 twin turbo, a 2L petrol turbo, and a 2.2L diesel turbo. The V6 twin turbo was capable of <370ps>. Like the other cars in the Genesis line-up, rear-wheel drive and AWD versions of the G70 were produced.

The G70's styling was an instant hit, widely praised for it elegant outline. In 2020, however, the car underwent a major redesign, intended to make it more similar to the luxurious G90 and G80. As a result, the G70 looked more polished, and even more striking.

In 2021, a shooting brake model, based on the sedan, was produced for the European market. Its stunning style made it an instant hit.

This particular car is a special tuned model, designed to comply with Gran Turismo's Gr.4 racing regulations.
DescriptionLong.0x00009345:
In September, 2020, Nissan unexpectedly unveiled a prototype for the new Fairlady Z model. Its design was reminiscent of the original S30 model first shown in 1969. Sports car enthusiasts the world over waited with bated breath until Nissan announced they would be following through with a production model to be sold in North America in summer 2021, and early 2022 for Japan. On paper the new model uses the same chassis code as the previous model, sharing much of the same basic construction, but for all intents and purposes this would be the 7th generation Fairlady Z.

This Z-car features a complex mix of sports car tradition and cutting edge technology. The exterior follows on from the S30's iconic long nose, while adding dynamic touches like undulating character lines and LED headlights. It also utilises the latest developments in cooling and aerodynamic performance.

For the engine, the previous generation's naturally aspirated engine has been done away with, replaced by the same powerful VR30DDTT 3L V6 twin-turbo engine as used in the Skyline 400R. Without relying on any electric assists, the engine produces a maximum <405ps>/<6500rpm> with 475 Nm (<48.4kgm>)/<1600rpm>-<5600rpm> maximum torque.

For the transmission, the car is available with either 9-speed automatic with manual mode or, in stark contrast to current motoring trends, a 6-speed manual version. Every precaution has been taken to save weight as well with the automatic model using a magnesium alloy transmission case to reduce weight. In addition, the front and rear dampers use monotube construction for improved response as well as an advanced launch control system which promises the fastest start off the line. This is the first time Nissan has ever offered such a system on their rear-wheel drive models.

Can the appeal of a the classic rear-wheel drive sports car survive in an industry increasingly moving towards automated driving and electrification? The new Fairlady Z may just be Nissan's answer to that question.m
DescriptionLong.0x00009BB1:
Subaru began competing with the original BRZ in the GT300 class of the Super GT series in 2012. In 2016, they were one of the top teams with some incredible performances on track. However, in autumn 2020, the 2nd generation BRZ premiered in North America, and later introduced in Japan in 2021, so a brand new machine was developed from the new model to race in the 2021 season.

As with the previous model, the engine was developed by STi and the body by R&D Sports. The vehicle as a whole was developed as an orthodox evolution of the previous model, carrying over many elements such as the basic structure and EJ20 engine.

Though based on the already aerodynamically superior 2nd generation BRZ, the body aerodynamics were further improved by adding details developed from the previous model. The car's cornering characteristics have also been improved through an overhaul of the weight distribution which included changing the position of the third damper.

Drivers Takuto Iguchi and Hideki Yamauchi both continued their roles in the new model for the 2021 season. The new BRZ showed incredible potential from the start, taking pole position in 4 of the 8 races for a glorious champtionship victory. Subaru had been competing in domestic GT racing since the 1997 All Japan Grand Touring Championship, but this was their first such achievement.
DescriptionLong.0x00009BB2:
A collaborative effort between Subaru and Toyota resulted in the front boxer engine, rear-wheel drive Subaru BRZ and Toyota 86 sports cars. In 2020, these sister cars would be renewed for their 2nd generation (ZD8) models.

In this process, the new platform carried over improvements from the late model original, while incorporating Subaru's inner frame construction through the entire chassis. This allowed for extra rigidity and reduced weight. The combination of a traditional Subaru 4-cylinder boxer engine with Toyota developed direct injection was also carried over to the new model. The biggest change to the formula though was the cylinder bore had been enlarged, increasing the engine displacement from 2 to 2.4L. This increased the power output to 173 kW (<235ps>)/250 Nm (<25.5kgm>) allowing for improved drivability across all conditions. The transmission was available as either a 6-speed manual or 6-speed automatic unit, with the automatic model featuring the EyeSight driver assistance system as standard equipment.

The model featured here is the 'S' grade, a high-end luxury model which features improved interior and exterior equipment such as the 18-inch wheels, ultra suede and leather combination seats, as well as an 8-speaker car stereo.U
DescriptionLong.0x00009D53:
With the LMP1 class TS050 - Hybrid, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing took 2 consecutive wins in the 2018-2019 and 2019-2020 seasons of the World Endurance Championship and 3 consecutive wins at Le Mans. However, from 2021 onwards, due to new regulations, the highest level of competition was moved to the LMH class. The GR010 HYBRID was developed to compete in these new conditions.

Being an all new design, it differs from the TS050 in many aspects, but where it differs most is the powertrain. The engine has changed from a <500ps> 2.4L V6 twin-turbo to a <680ps> 3.5L V6 twin-turbo. Meanwhile, the <500ps> front and rear wheel electric motors have changed to a <272ps> system on the front wheels only. This results in a four-wheel drive system that uses only electric power on the front and engine power on the back wheels.

For the 2021 season, car No. 7 was driven by the team of Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi and Jose Maria Lopez and car No. 8 by Sebastien Buemi, Kazuki Nakajima and Brendon Hartley. This season saw Toyota take their 4th consecutive, and 6th total, Le Mans win, taking centre stage at the beginning of the hypercar era.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A042:
The world's largest hill climb race, the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, is held every summer on Pikes Peak Highway near Colorado Springs in the United States.

The <20km> course covers an elevation difference of <1440m> from <2862m> to <4302m> above sea level. It has 156 corners ranging from tight <60km/h> hairpins to <200km/h> sweeping high speed curves. Additionally, the temperature difference between the starting point and the finish line can be as much as 20 degrees. All these make for extremely harsh conditions for any race car.

The Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special is a monster machine developed specifically to compete in these conditions. The frame is of an all-new design using an aluminium space frame. In order to maximise performance, the powertrain has been extensively modified, moving the engine from the base model's front position to a midship configuration. The fully tuned 2.5L V6 engine has been fitted with twin turbochargers allowing it to produce a maximum <995ps> and <95kgm> maximum torque.

The body is considerably light at just 800 kg, so in order to keep it planted on the slippery road surfaces the body has been fitted a massive front spoiler and rear wing developed as a result of thorough wind tunnel testing. These modifications have changed the base production model Escudo into a fearsome beast of a machine.

This beast was driven by none other than Nobuhiro 'Monster' Tajima. Having mastered dirt racing with 7 consecutive wins in the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championships, he began competing at Pikes Peak in 1988. In 1995 he would achieve the first ever overall win for a Japanese driver at Pikes Peak driving the Suzuki Twin-Engine Escudo.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A043:
This car is a Gr.3 version of the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo, a lightweight sports car combining the sporting philosophies of Suzuki's 2 and 4 wheeled models. This model is a realisation of Suzuki's motorsporting prowess, extensively tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations.

The base Suzuki VGT uses the 1,340 cm³ (<1340cc>) Hayabusa engine linked to 3 high-power electric motors on an all-wheel drive powertrain. This Gr.3 version, however, has been changed to a simple front-engine, rear-wheel drive layout with a V8 twin-turbo powerplant comprised of 2 Hayabusa engine blocks for a total displacement of 2,680 cm³ (<2680cc>). In this form, the monstrous engine is able to produce a maximum <586ps> at an astoundingly high <10000rpm>.

Compared to the base model, the design aesthetics have been altered to achieve increased downforce, featuring an enlarged front spoiler as well as the addition of front and rear diffusers, a GT wing and air ducting on the bonnet. Additionally, use of carbon fibre parts across the car has greatly reduced its weight.

The car's livery is a vivid representation of Suzuki's passion for motorsports, featuring graphics using Metallic Triton Blue and Metallic Mystic Silver, the Suzuki motorcycle racing team colours.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A1BD:
Every August in the U.S., the most beautiful cars from throughout all of car history are gathered for the world famous Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance. The 2014 winner of the Gran Turismo Trophy, just one of the awards available, was this Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder, chassis No. 2078.

A6 was the designation for a series of 6-cylinder racing cars developed by Maserati from 1947 to 1956. The GCS, intended for sports car championship competition, started out resembling a 2-seater version of the classic cigar shaped grand prix cars. However, after regulations changed in 1953, a number of coachbuilders began to fashion their own designs for the tubular frame.

Chassis No. 2078 is one such car that was adorned with a gorgeous Spyder body created by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi. The <170ps> engine was constructed by Gioacchino Colombo. This car raced for the Maserati works team in the 1954 season, achieving 5 class victories and 3 overall victories.v
DescriptionLong.0x0000A1BE:
The 'Hakosuka' (short for square-Skyline) GT-R that took Japanese motorsports by storm ended its illustrious career in 1972. But the legend of the Skyline lived on, and fans continued to hope for its return to the circuit for many years thereafter.

Their dreams came to life in 1982 when Nissan created a Silhouette Formula car based on the 6th generation Skyline '2000RS', powered by a 4 Valve DOHC engine that had not been in the lineup since the 'Kenmeri' (nicknamed for its Ken&Mary commercials) GT-R. This was the Skyline Super Silhouette.

The 'super silhouette' race cars were pure race cars that maintained the silhouette of production models. These cars were active in the 'Fuji Super Silhouette Series', which began as the supporting race for the Fuji Grand Champion Races in 1979, but the Silhouette Series soon became more popular than the main Grand Champion event.

The Skyline Super Silhouette is one of the most iconic cars from this series, with a look that is far from ordinary to say the least. Sporting a chin spoiler that extends far forward of the car almost scraping the tarmac, fenders expanded to extreme levels in both the front and rear, combined with a large rear wing, it was powered by a 2.1 litre 4 cylinder turbocharged racing engine called the LZ20B. Often spitting flames out of its exhaust located just below the left hand door, it was an incredible presence on the track that completely mesmerized car enthusiasts and race fans of its day.

In the hands of the legendary driver Masahiro Hasemi, it fought in the 1982 to 1984 race seasons with 8 wins to its name. Due to regulation changes it was only active for 3 seasons in 19 rounds of racing, but it is the 'extraordinary' Skyline that is still fondly remembered to this day.Q
DescriptionLong.0x0000A33F:
The original Pontiac GTO debuted in 1964 to great success and is said to be the original road-going muscle car. However the 1968 second generation model changed to a more style oriented fastback and while it wasn't lacking in performance it failed to stand up to more powerful rivals that had arrived on the scene.

In a bid to make a comeback, General Motors released 'The Judge' in 1969. Costing a mere $332, this sports package included a staggering amount of equipment as standard. It included unique decals and racing stripes, a Hurst shifter, heavy duty suspension, wider tyres, and a rear spoiler. The engine was upgraded to the 6.6L 'Ram Air III' V8, which was listed at <366ps> but rumoured to produce much more. As a result 'The Judge' was able to top its rivals in both presence and performance, gaining it widespread attention.

Just one year later though, strict emissions regulations came into effect in the United States and muscle cars like the GTO began to decline.a
DescriptionLong.0x0000A341:
As 911 has always formed the backbone of Porsche's sports car racing endeavours, racing focused 911 models have always been part of their catalogue line-up and available to the public. 2015 however, saw the arrival of an outlier. A motorsports version of the less powerful mid-ship Cayman coupe was introduced as the Cayman GT4.

Its most notable feature is the powertrain. Based on that of the 911 Carrera S, it combines a 3.8L flat-6 engine with a 6-speed manual transmission. What's more is it produces <385ps>, more than the base model 911 Carrera.

The brakes and suspension also use parts from the 991 GT3 and the  ride height has been lowered <30mm> from the standard position. The exterior has also been changed to match the car's new image with a unique front lip and fixed rear wing.

A glance over the option list will also show you track focused this model is, featuring a roll cage, fire extinguishers and a 6-point harness for the driver's seat.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A460:
The S14 Silvia debuted in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model, and with a new larger body Nissan hoped to continue their previous success.

The S14 is <1730mm> wide compared to the S13's <1690> and the track width has also been increased to match. The new model is also <30mm> longer at <4500mm>, and <5mm> taller at <1295mm> for an overall larger body. The softer lines of the body design though make the width of the car stand out the most. The K's grade model also featured 16-inch wheels as standard.

The engine is a retuned version of the S13's SR20 series. The highest grade K's model features an intercooled turbocharger and produces <15ps> more than the previous generation at <220ps>/<28.0kgm> with the naturally aspirated Q's and J's models producing <160ps>/<19.2kgm>. The basic suspension structure has also been carried over from the S13 utilising front struts with a multilink system on the rear. The car was also available with the 'Super HICAS' electronic rear wheel steering system.

The S14 had also placed an extra focus on luxury to increase its appeal as a FR coupe, but the crash of Japan's bubble economy in 1991 had shrunk the coupe market considerably and the car struggled to sell. In an attempt to revitalize the model, Nissan released a facelift model in 1996 with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler for a more sharp and striking appearance. As the number of affordable rear-wheel drive coupes dwindled through the 90s, the S14 can be considered a very important car for carrying that design DNA onto the next generation.

The S14 Silvia was sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.O
DescriptionLong.0x0000A461:
Starting in 1948, Porsche has founded its reputation as one of the world’s premier automotive manufacturers by creating supremely elegant and lightweight sports cars. Sports cars which are not defined by extreme horsepower, but which are instead characterised by a highly efficient power/weight ratio combined with timeless and efficient design.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo follows in this tradition of the German manufacturer and is at the same time a truly modern and bold statement about the future of the sports car. It merges elements of the iconic design of historic Porsche sports cars with race car genes of the record-breaking 919 Hybrid and the pioneering spirit of Porsche’s first electric sports car, the Taycan, into a high-performance lightweight sports car.

Exterior and interior design flow seamlessly into one another and provide drivers with the feeling of becoming one with the car – especially once they take a seat in the cockpit of the state-of-the-art carbon monocoque chassis.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo’s dual electric engine layout delivers a system power output of 820 kW (<1114ps>) and a maximum torque of 1,090 Nm (<111kgm>). An innovative active aerodynamic system dynamically reacts to all driving situations to enhance the car’s performance. Perfectly suited for the demanding corners and high-speed segments found on tracks like the Nürburgring Nordschleife or on alpine roads.J
DescriptionLong.0x0000A462:
As the threat of global climate change looms ever closer, automotive manufacturers push forward with the electrification of powertrains in an attempt to reduce their carbon dioxide emissions. Volkswagen was one of the first companies to take up the challenge, but looking towards the introduction of their all electric 'ID.' brand in 2020, they planned to build a car that would serve as a role model for the possibilities of electric vehicles. The result of this project was the ID.R prototype race car.

The ID.R's body is made from carbon-fibre with oversized wings placed on the front and rear to produce maximum downforce. At <5.2m> long, the car is relatively large but actually weighs less than <1100kg>. The dual-motor 4WD system produces a maximum 500 kW (<680ps>) / 650 Nm (<66.3kgm>), allowing for a 0-<100km>/h acceleration time of just 2.25s. These performance statistics put it well on par with race cars using internal combustion engines.

In the real world, the ID.R competed in numerous motorsports events around the world with record breaking results. At the 2018 Pikes Peak Hill Climb, driver Romain Dumas set a record of 7m57s, the first ever run to break the 8 minute mark. Again at the Nürburgring Nordschliefe, the ID.R set the record for fastest lap by an EV at 6m5s. At the Goodwood Festival of Speed, the car became the first to ever finish the legendary hillclimb in under 40 seconds with a record of 39.9s.

Since the birth of the automobile, people have been enamoured with the pursuit of speed. The ID.R is proof that even in the age of electrification, this fascination lives on.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A51E:
The C10 Skyline, nicknamed the 'Hakosuka' (meaning box skyline), handed the baton to a new model in September 1972. The new model C110 was given the nickname 'Kenmeri' from its commercials, and was an explosive hit after its debut. The body had a fluid form, omitting all unnecessary lines. However it still had the surface lines and the 4 round headlights that were identifying marks of the Skyline.

The GT-R emblem returned to this Kenmeri in the following year, in January 1973. The model code of this GT-R was KPGC110, and it was equipped with the same legendary engine, the S20 inline-6-cylinder. There was no change in the <160ps> maximum power and <18.0kgm> maximum torque. The front strut and rear semi-trailing arm suspension was also the same as the previous GT-R, but the new four-wheel disc brakes were an advancement at the time.

With a size of <4460mm> in length, <1695mm> width, and <1380mm> height, it looked one size larger than the 'Hakosuka'.

If all went well, this Kenmeri GT-R should have won many race series as well, but what this car had to fight was the rising emissions regulations.

The S20 was almost a pure racing engine, and could not overcome this unremitting requirement. So Nissan made a difficult decision. After only 3 months and 197 cars built, this Kenmeri GT-R disappeared, without ever having raced. Thereafter, Nissan would mothball the GT-R emblem for 16 years, until its comeback with the R32.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A51F:
Released in 2015, the 4th generation 'ND' Roadster received worldwide praise for its return to the Roadster's original concept of 'Jinba Ittai' ("horse and rider moving as one"). The essence of the ND was most purely expressed in the NR-A grade, a motorsports oriented base model.

The NR-A first joined the line-up on the 2nd generation 'NB' model, where it was introduced with the idea of providing an easy way for anyone to experience the joy of circuit racing. These ideas are carried on in the ND version which has been modified with a particular focus on sports driving.

The power plant frame that connects the transmission to the rear differential has been upgraded, along with accompanying parts such as the driveshaft, LSD and differential case. The radiator and brake rotors have also been upsized, and the suspension uses height adjustable dampers made by Bilstein. Another useful feature is the driver is now about to pull up statistics like fuel consumption on the Multi-Information Display from the steering wheel mounted audio control switches.

This 2022 model has further improvements, with the introduction of the new Kinematic Posture Control system greatly increasing rear-end stability. The options list also features racing equipment such as roll bars and bucket seats making it easy to turn this car into a thoroughbred racing machine.

The NR-A may be the answer to the prayers of many a driver, offering as much fun on the city streets as on the track.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A5FF:
The BMW 2 Series coupe is popular as a high performance rear-wheel drive compact. The BMW M2 Competition is an extreme machine that fills the same engine compartment with the3L twin-turbo inline-6 'S55' engine from the M3 and M4.

What you'll notice first is the captivating bodywork. With its bulging overfenders, the exterior is the embodiment of speed. Though it measures only <4475mm> in length, it's actually roughly the same size as the E36 M3. Whether in the city or out in the winding backroads, the car offers an incredible sense of control, as if the drivers own nerves reached out to the far corners of the body.

The S55 engine offers a maximum power output of <410ps> with <56.1kgm> maximum torque. Even up against BMW's long history of peak performance inline-6 engines, this model has a exceptional high revving performance, and as the boost builds its explosive power emerges.

No compromises have been made on the running gear set to receive this power either. To reduce unsprung weight the aluminium suspension components have been specially tuned for purpose. Meanwhile, the torque vectoring 'Active M Differential' ensures the car turns exactly where you want it to.

Now that the M3 and M4 have moved to a higher segment, this car may be the ultimate expression of BMW's 'Sheer Driving Pleasure'.g
DescriptionLong.0x0000A600:
The Sierra was a relatively standard family car with an aerodynamic hatchback body, produced by Ford Europe from 1982.

But in 1985, the impression of car enthusiasts regarding the Sierra took a big turn. This was because the famed Cosworth added the Sierra RS Cosworth to the selection, known affectionately as the 'Cossie' among enthusiasts. The Sierra RS Cosworth was powered by a 2 litre inline 4 tuned to <206ps> with DOHC and a turbocharger. The chassis was reinforced, and the exterior was upgraded with fender extensions and a large rear spoiler.

A year later it was further increased in power to <227ps>, and a 500 unit limited Sierra RS 500 Cosworth was added to the lineup, with an engine reinforced for racing use, and better aerodynamic details.

And of course all of these improvements were developed for touring car racing. From 1988 to 1990, the Sierra won a number of series championship titles in the international Group A category in countries such as Germany, UK, Australia, Japan and New Zealand.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A601:
The S14 Silvia debuted in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model, and with a new larger body Nissan hoped to continue their previous success.

The S14 is <1730mm> wide compared to the S13's <1690> and the track width has also been increased to match. The new model is also <30mm> longer at <4500mm>, and <5mm> taller at <1295mm> for an overall larger body. The softer lines of the body design though make width of the car stand out the most. The K's grade model also featured 16-inch wheels as standard.

The engine is a retuned version of the S13's SR20 series. The highest grade K's model features an intercooled turbocharger and produces <15ps> more than the previous generation at <220ps>/<28.0kgm> with the naturally aspirated Q's and J's models producing <160ps>/<19.2kgm>. The basic suspension structure has also been carried over from the S13 utilising front struts with a multilink system on the rear. The car was also available with the 'Super HICAS' electronic rear wheel steering system.

In 1996, Nissan released a facelift model with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler for a more sharp and striking appearance.

The 'Aero' model featured here was added to the Q's and K's models in spring 1995 as the highest level trim grade. The exterior features unique bumpers along with front and rear spoilers. The interior features a leather wrapped steering wheel and shift knob as well as white gauge faces. These changes proved to be popular among drivers and the grade was continued on the facelift model.

As the number of affordable rear-wheel drive coupes dwindled through the 90s, the S14 Silvia can be considered a very important car for carrying that design DNA onto the next generation. It was also popular overseas where it was sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.O
DescriptionLong.0x0000A608:
The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo is the first Ferrari single-seater concept car dedicated to the world of virtual motor sport, with a spectacular and futuristic design founded in the Prancing Horse’s unequalled racing heritage. The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo draws its inspiration from the fascinating world of Ferrari’s hugely successful 1960s and ‘70s sports-prototypes. Below hyper-modern bodywork and dramatic proportions, the car hides the DNA of masterpieces such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S. It is a nod to the past, yet a powerful hint of the future of endurance racing.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo’s architecture is crafted around an advanced aerodynamic design and is equipped with the same engine architecture that powers the Ferrari 499P. Here, though, the engine has been made more extreme to develop no less than 1,030 CV (<1030ps>) at <9000rpm>, with an additional 240 kW (<326ps>) available through three electric motors, one on the rear axle and one on each of the front wheels.L
DescriptionLong.0x0000A6A6:
The Chiron is a super sports car unveiled by Bugatti in 2016. This limited production model was introduced as a follow-up to the Veyron, with only 500 units available worldwide.

The exterior features large C-shaped lines that encircle the cabin and also serve as air intakes. It also features an accentuated centre-line inspired by the Type 57 Atlantic Coupe that increases straight line stability.

The carbon fibre chassis provides the same level of rigidity as an LMP1 race car and houses a 8L W16 quad-turbo engine. This engine has been extensively tuned since the Veyron iteration to a maximum power output of <1500ps> and a maximum torque rating of <163.1kgm>.

The car is able to accelerate from 0-<100km/h> in 2.5s and a pre-production prototype was able to reach a maximum speed of <490.48km/h>.

In 2018, the Chiron Sport was introduced featuring an improved chassis weighing <18kg> less than the original. In 2019, the limited edition 'Chiron Sport 110 ans Bugatti' was released to celebrate the 110th anniversary of Bugatti. Only 20 of these cars were made.G
DescriptionLong.0x0000A6A7:
The byword for the all-American sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette saw a historic change in 2019. Introduced that year, the eighth generation Corvette became the very first in the line to use a midship layout.

This revolutionary change is apparent from a single look at the exterior. The Chevrolet's iconic long nose is nowhere to be seen, and with the cabin moved forward, the body fits the classic midship profile. Without an engine, the front section now serves as luggage space; meanwhile, behind the engine sits another luggage area big enough for a golf bag.

The V8 engine at the heart of the car is a the new generation small block LT2 which was developed from the previous generation model C7's LT1 engine. With 6.2L of displacement, it is able to produce <502ps>/<65.0kgm> but also features fuel saving features like cylinder deactivation. The transmission is now only available as an 8-speed dual-clutch automatic but manual control is also possible using steering wheel mounted paddle shifters. The suspension uses double wishbone construction on all 4 corners, and is available with a height adjustment system for handling high kerbs and other obstacles.

The driver centred cockpit features a multifunctional infotainment system controlled by an 8-inch touchscreen. With the engine bay moved to the rear of the cabin, the new generation Corvette has shown itself to be a contender with exceptional performance in GT car racing.O
DescriptionLong.0x0000A6A8:
Citroën were committed to front-wheel drive, and this Citroën DS is their masterpiece, made with all the most cutting edge technologies of the time.

It first appeared at the 1955 Salon de l'Automobile. While many other manufacturers were still producing cars in the pre-war style, the DS was a stunning vision of the future. With its avant-garde aerodynamic body and revolutionary hydropneumatic suspension system it was nicknamed the 'flying saucer.' Development was led by André Lefèbvre, while the comparatively large <4.8m> long body was design by Italian Flaminio Bertoni, who had also worked on the classic 2CV.

With such a forward-thinking design, the popularity of the DS did not wane for some time. Including various equipment and engine upgrades, the car continued to be produced for 20 years. In 1964, the 'Pallas' grade was added with luxury interior and exterior fixtures. Then in 1967, the car was given a more modern visage with the 2 round headlights replaced by 4 headlights in covered units. 

The DS 21 Pallas is a 2.1L engine model produced from 1969. The large seats and spacious interior remain, and the lightweight body is elegantly propelled by the <116.7ps> engine.

While originally conceived as an everyday passenger vehicle, the DS was also loved as a state car, ambulance and often a taxi. It is one of the most important French cars in automotive history.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A6A9:
After capturing the double title of both driver and maker championships thanks to the ST185's brilliant showing in 1993, Toyota introduced the new ST205 Celica the following year, aiming to achieve even more victories.

Although the new Celica had a bigger body, it had better weight distribution due to the enhanced stability from the expanded wheelbase and wheeltrack. Works team TTE was involved from the start of development, and key contributions were the improvement of overall aerodynamic and cooling performance.

The Celica was planned to debut in the 1994 1000 Lakes Rally, but due to unexpected delays in undercarriage development it spent the season running trial races.

Entering in 1995 as a full-scale participant, the Celica battled with the newly improved Subaru Impreza, and Didier Auriol brought in the first win in the 4th round at the Tour de Corse. Although Toyota continued to be afflicted by problems with the super strut suspension, the team continued racing and making improvements throughout the season in order to overcome the handicap.

In the 7th round at Catalonia, the Celica was found to be in violation of the intake restrictor diameter regulation and was stripped of all points for the season. In opposition to the decision Toyota ceased participation in the WRC and the ST205's appearance on the gala stage of the event was limited to just one season.

Although it was only active for a short time, this machine's gallant silhouette imprinted itself on the hearts of many fans. When discussing the Toyota rally scene, it is one car that must be mentioned.t
DescriptionLong.0x0000A827:
Italdesign was founded in 1968 in Turin, Italy, and has designed and engineered more than 300 production cars, and premiered more than 100 concept cars at the most important world auto shows. Many of its pieces have been featured in Gran Turismo.

Some of the cars designed by Italdesign have gone on to become genuine movie stars, such as the DeLorean DMC 12, which starred in the 'Back to the Future' trilogy, or the Lotus Esprit, which was driven by Roger Moore in 'The Spy Who Loved Me'.

The Italdesign EXENEO Vision Gran Turismo continues the long Italian tradition of Gran Turismo automobiles, though updated with cutting-edge technology. Inspired by the 2013 all-road, mid-rear engine, compact GT Italdesign Parcour, this concept car features four different chassis settings (track, snow, off-road and urban), and was designed to be driven both on circuits and off-road tracks.

A powerful V10 midship engine, together with two 200 kW (<272ps>) electric motors, assures a total output of 910 kW (<1237.3ps>) of power, allowing the EXENEO VGT to reach a top speed of <380km/h>, with an acceleration from 0 to <100km/h> in 2.5 secs. A 7-speed gearbox, Individual Wheel Drive (IWD) and KERS recovery system complete the power train. To ensure maximum stability, intelligent suspension adapts automatically to different types of terrain.

Literally developed ‘around the driver,’ this VGT features a crystal sphere cockpit. The V10 engine behind the driver further contributes to an integrated feel, while the electric engines in front allow for maximum push during acceleration. A carbon fibre and aluminium tape envelop the driver and engine as a 'xenium', Latin for 'gift for the guest’—and what a gift it is.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A828:

DescriptionLong.0x0000A8B2:
With their innovative ideas and forward thinking engineering skills, Honda has achieved a number of technological revolutions. A great example of this is their first endeavours in F1 in 1964 when they were still relatively unknown as a car manufacturer. The machine they developed was the RA271 which used an aluminium shell over a space frame body, with a 1.5L V12 engine in an unusual transverse midship position. Its uniqueness, however, would be its downfall and it failed to make any achievements in its debut year.

In 1965, Honda put the machine through a radical overhaul resulting in the RA272. The RA272E engine was a more efficient version of the previous V12 using lightened components. The construction of the rear suspension was changed from an inboard to an outboard setup, which allowed the weight to be reduced from <525kg> to <498kg>, a major improvement. At the steering wheels sat Ronnie Bucknum in his second year as well as new driver Richie Ginther.

At the start of the 1965 season, the extra power from the RA272's new engine showed great potential but the car suffered from poor stability. The team opted to skip Round 7's German Grand Prix to make improvements to their machine. The engine was moved <100mm> to the rear with other adjustments made to the body, suspension and exhaust.

In the final race of the season, Round 10's Mexican Grand Prix, the RA272 finally showed its true potential. After starting in 3rd, Ginther moved to pole and stayed there until the finish, winning Honda their first F1 victory. Teammate Bucknum came in 5th for their first ever double finish.

Honda has achieved numerous F1 victories since then, but the RA272 is the historically invaluable car that opened their path to victory.
DescriptionLong.0x0000A8C2:
Appearing in 1973, the 911 Carrera RS 2.7 was the first model in the long history of the Porsche 911 to feature the RS badge. RS stands for 'Rennsport' or simply 'racing sport' in English, and as this name suggests it was developed as a homologation model for the FIA's Group 4 category.

The 2.4L engine from the base model 1973 911 S has been enlarged to 2.7L, now producing <210ps>. The front end features an air dam which allows for the addition of an oil cooler. The rear of the car features the iconic duck tail spoiler as standard, with stretched rear fenders to house the new wider rear tyres.

The Carrera RS 2.7 was available in 3 grades: Touring, Sport and Racing, though even the luxury Touring model weighed less than <1100kg>.

The car was originally produced in a limited homologation run of 500 units; however, it sold out almost immediately, leading Porsche to increase production. In total 1,580 such cars were produced.
DescriptionLong.0x0000AA88:
2019 was a year of reform for the German touring car championships (DTM). The adoption of Class 1 regulations which included the downsizing of engines made it possible to co-host races with the Japanese Super GT hosted under the same regulations. 

The car that Audi sent into this new category was this new RS 5 DTM powered by a brand new engine. The exterior remains the same as the previous season, but the engine was changed from the normally aspirated 4L V8 to a turbocharged 2L inline 4. This provided a dramatic reduction in weight and improvements in weight balance, as well as providing over 600 HP which greatly outpowered its predecessor. It was a totally new machine on the inside. 

In 2019, Audi introduced six of these RS 5 DTMs into the series in their works teams. With customer teams also added to the mix, the RS 5 DTMs were a force to be reckoned with, but the car that showed the most outstanding performance among all of them was car number 33, driven by ace driver René Rast. With victory after victory from the opening rounds, it finished the season with a pole to win in the final round of Hockenheim in race 2, winning against Nico Müller, also in a RS 5. Not only did it take the championship title this year, Audi Sport Team Rosberg with René also won the team title, making car number 33 an iconic double title winner. 

The final round of the DTM was a mixed class race hosted together with Japan's Super GT GT500 class machines, and there was also an interleague match hosted in Japan. However, the outbreak of the Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic prompted Audi to withdraw from DTM competition. The Class 1 regulations lost its objective as a result, and ended after only 2 seasons.

The Audi RS 5 was a car that truly embodied the ambition and sparkle of the short-lived Class 1 regulations, and has made its mark in motorsports history.
DescriptionLong.0x0000AA8A:
The MAZDA3 is a 4th generation C-segment passenger car of Mazda first released in November 2018, and was called the Axela in Japan until then. With this 4th generation model being the first car in a new generation of products at Mazda, the name was unified globally under the 'MAZDA3' name.

As before it features fastback and saloon models, but with the application of Mazda's 'KODO' design, the character of each car became more defined. The shape of the fastback model was especially impressive, with the delicate form of the body panels beautifully expressing the transition of light.

The engine powering the car is from the new generation SKYACTIV engines of Mazda. The mainstay models were the 1.5L and 2L direct injection petrol, and the 1.8L diesel turbo engine, with a 2L 'Mild-Hybrid' (M-Hybrid) model following a little later. This Mild-Hybrid is powered by a SKYACTIV-X engine that introduces proprietary spark controlled compression ignition, and is a revolutionary engine that supresses NOx output without using expensive solutions like the Urea-SCR.

The X Burgundy Selection is a special model with burgundy coloured interior on the Grade X model. Equipped with wine coloured genuine leather seats and dashboard, this is a special model with a classy, mature aura.
DescriptionLong.0x0000AAA1:
At the Frankfurt show of 1983, Porsche debuted the 'Gruppe B' concept model. This was a design study of a four wheel drive road car that was being developed for competition in the 'Group B' top category of the WRC, that started in 1982.

2 years later after this reveal in 1985, the road going version of this model was unveiled -  The Porsche 959. While it carries over the basic structure of the Porsche 911, it was packed with revolutionary technology. The engine was a <2850cc> twin turbocharged horizontally opposed 6 cylinder, with a maximum output of 450 horsepower. This was mated to a 6 speed manual transmission.

But the cutting edge feature of this car was the electronically controlled four wheel drive system that would convey the power of this high output engine without loss to the ground. The system actively controls the drive ratio between the front and rear wheels according to the road surface conditions, and it was possible to select a drive mode that matches your current driving condition. It was a new generation of four wheel drive systems that provided not only control stability at ultra high speeds, but also ease of use. 

292 units of the Porsche 959 was produced for Group B homologation, but due to the termination of the Group B category it never made it into the WRC. But it did go on to set great records in competition, even winning overall at the Paris-Dakar Rally which is considered one of the toughest rallies in the world.

Many of the technical accomplishments of the 959 such as the four wheel drive system were carried over into other commercial models like the 911, and it set a new bar for sports cars overall. In this way the Porsche 959 is a very important model in automotive history. n
DescriptionLong.0x0000AAA3:
The mini van is a popular category of utility cars specific to Japan. It is a highly competitive segment with each manufacturer always vying for the upper hand. But the car that has held onto the undisputed title of the ultimate premium mini van, is the Toyota Alphard. 

Since its first appearance in 2002, there has been an ongoing pursuit and evolution of what makes a 'Premium mini van'. Today the Alphard is often one of the first choices when looking for a limousine to host VIP guests, and is one of the most premium luxury cars of Japan.

The 3rd generation Alphard that appeared in 2015 was polished one step further for quality and comfort. A prime example of this effort was the 'Executive Lounge' luxury grade model that really pushed the level of comfort in the 2nd row of seating. The 'Executive Lounge Seats' which are special for this model are independent seats that are one size larger than the seats of the standard model, equipped with heating and ventilation features as well as a folding mini-table. The quality of the leather and stitching was a major point of focus, and provides a level of comfort equal to a first class airline seat.

A minor model change was introduced in 2017, with the 3.5L V6 engine being upgraded from <280ps> to <301ps>. The transmission was also optimized with more gears going from a 6 speed automatic to an 8 speed automatic. And with additional improvements to increase rigidity on the floor and openings, its driving performance and comfort has improved an additional notch.A
DescriptionLong.0x0000AAA5:
Soon after its establishment in the 1950s, Porsche gained great fame in motorsports around the world with its 356 series models and genuine mid-engine racing cars derived from the 356, such as the 550 Spyder. 

One important milestone that followed in their footsteps was the Porsche Carrera GTS that was born in 1963. It is also referred to as the 904 GTS from its development code name, and was a sportscar that was developed to meet the changes in the World Sportscar Championship regulations of its day.  

In the 1950s, the World Championship races were fought in low production, pure racing cars. But from the regulation revisions in 1961, its main event became the GT Class using mass production sportscars. And in order to compete in this GT Class, it was necessary to clear a homologation production count of 100 cars. 

The Porsche Carrera GTS was developed and produced using a ladder frame that was more suited for mass production, that would then be covered by a light weight FRP body. For Porsche this was the first time utilizing this format. The car is also known for the low and beautiful styling by Ferdinand Alexander Porsche, the grandson of the founder Dr. Ferdinand Porsche. The engine mounted midship is an air cooled horizontally opposed 4 cylinder, but it was possible to mount a 6 cylinder or even an 8 cylinder for racing. 

The Porsche Carrera GTS showed fantastic performance from its debut with wins in races like the Targa Florio, and even achieving class victories in endurance races at the Nürburgring and the Le Mans. It also succeeded in dominating the 1964 GT Class Championship.
DescriptionLong.0x0000AB80:
The Mercedes-AMG GT3 is based on the Mercedes-AMG GT sports car, itself unveiled to the public at the Paris Motor Show in 2014. This FIA (Federation Internationale de l'Automobile) homologated GT3 race car appeared on the international motorsports scene in 2016.

This 2020 update model was unveiled in 2019 with a focus on further reducing its running costs as a customer racing car. Improvements like a longer lifespan on the engine and better protection for the radiator through a redesigned front end help make the high costs of running a GT3 car more affordable for privateer teams. 

In addition, the car's aerodynamics were improved through the addition of a front splitter and winglets, as well as a large wing and diffuser on the rear. The designers have also tried to reduce the car's weight by using carbon fibre in many of the parts.

The lower portion of the front grille has been significantly widened, and the front and rear lights have also been updated. Though it keeps the distinctive design of the previous model, the details on the car have been updated to match the refreshed production model. t
DescriptionLong.0x0000AB81:
In spring 2023, Japan's top formula racing series, Super Formula saw the debut of the new Dallara SF23 Super Formula car.

The SF23 uses a number of new technologies from the 'SUPER FORMULA NEXT50' motorsports sustainability project headed by Japan Race Promotion, the organisers of Super Formula.

First, the body of the SF23, which is based on the SF19 introduced in 2019, uses bio-composite materials produced by the Bcomp company. This has allowed for a 75% reduction in CO2 emissions from the raw materials and construction processes while keeping the same weight and rigidity characteristics as the previous carbon fibre shell. The racing tires provided by Yokohama Rubber have also been developed for sustainability. The new tires use sustainable materials such as naturally derived polymers and recycled rubbers. And though they use 33% sustainably sourced materials, the tires achieve the same handling characteristics as before. With the Yokohama Carbon Neutral Racing Tires equipped, the car becomes the ideal of a carbon neutral racing machine as outlined in the 'SUPER FORMULA NEXT50' project.

To achieve another of the 'SUPER FORMULA NEXT50' goals, increased entertainment value, the aerodynamics of the car have been overhauled as well. This will allow drivers more opportunity to show off their skills in close quarters racing than ever before. For the engines, as before, teams will have the choice between a Toyota or Honda powerplant.
